captions.caption: A man in a tan jacket speaks to the camera in front of a farm building.
The man continues speaking as he stands in the farmyard.
He points toward a large metal grain dryer in the background.
The man explains he needs to go inside the grain dryer today.
He walks toward a yellow tractor parked nearby.
A close-up shows the man's hand turning the ignition key.
The tractor's engine starts, and smoke comes from the exhaust.
The man sits on the idling tractor, ready to move.
A view from behind the man shows him preparing to drive.
The Millennial Farmer logo animation begins on screen.
The Minnesota-shaped logo is displayed on a white background.
The text "MILLENNIAL FARMER" appears below the state logo.
A circular logo with a green sprout fades onto the screen.
Text appears stating the video is brought to you by a sponsor.
The Farmers Business Network logo is shown on the screen.
The sponsor logo remains visible before transitioning back to the video.
The camera captures a first-person view of the tractor driving forward.
Two dogs run across the dirt path in front of the tractor.
The tractor moves into a harvested cornfield under an overcast sky.
The front loader of the tractor is visible as it navigates the field.
The tractor continues driving through the rows of corn stalks.
The camera focuses on a dusty metal door on the grain dryer.
A gloved hand reaches for the latch of the dusty metal panel.
The door opens to reveal a thick layer of reddish dust.
More of the fine reddish material spills out from the opening.
The man clears some dust away from the edge with his hand.
A shovel is used to begin removing the reddish dust from the machine.
A shovel full of the reddish material is tossed out of the opening.
Another scoop of dust is removed from the crowded compartment.
The man continues shoveling the reddish material out of the dryer.
A large pile of dust is thrown out, creating a small cloud.
The shoveling continues as the man clears the access point.
The camera zooms in to show the interior filled with red dust.
A view of the dark, dusty interior of the grain dryer is shown.
The man reaches in to feel the fluffy texture of the red dust.
He shows the accumulated dust inside the metal structure.
The shovel rests against the opening of the dusty compartment.
The man comments on how light and fluffy the dust is this year.
A metal shovel scoops up a large amount of the reddish dust.
The shovel is lifted out, carrying a full load of material.
The dust is dumped outside, falling from the shovel in a stream.
The shovel is pushed back into the pile for another scoop.
Another load of reddish dust is removed from the machine.
The man continues the repetitive task of shoveling out the dust.
A large amount of the reddish material is tossed aside.
The shovel is visible as it clears more of the interior space.
The man talks to another person about the lightness of the dust.
He continues shoveling while discussing the material being removed.
More fine red dust is shoveled out from the machine's interior.
The shovel works through the deep pile of dust inside the dryer.
The scene shifts to the man inside a long, sloped metal trough.
He uses a shovel to clear dust from the floor of the metal channel.
The reddish material is pushed along the length of the trough.
The shovel scrapes against the metal as it moves the dust.
A large pile of light material is pushed toward a discharge point.
The man continues cleaning the narrow, metal-lined internal space.
The camera shows a view down the length of the partially cleaned trough.
The metal surface becomes visible as the dust is cleared away.
The camera pans along the internal structure of the grain dryer.
The man points out the middle column of the machine from the inside.
